name: mzTab-M 2.1.0-M Profile for MetaboLights Submissions
description: MetaboLights submission profile extending the HUPO-PSI mzTab-M 2.1.0-M Default Profile with stricter curation rules for contacts, samples, species ontologies, assays, protocols, study variable groups, and summary quantification

$.description: MetaboLights mzTab-M submissions MUST define the metadata and smallMoleculeSummary sections

$.metadata.description: Metadata MUST include all mandatory MetaboLights study metadata properties (including protocol, sample, contact, and study_variable_group) and is recommended to include software and publication

$.metadata.publication.description: At least one publication entry is recommended in metadata

value_constraint.description: Recommends at least 1 publication entry in metadata.publication

$.metadata.contact.description: At least one study contact MUST be defined in metadata for MetaboLights submissions

value_constraint.description: Requires at least 1 contact entry in metadata.contact

$.metadata.contact[*].description: Each contact entry MUST define name, email, and affiliation, and is recommended to include an ORCID identifier

$.metadata.contact[*].name.description: Contact full name MUST be at least 5 characters long

value_constraint.description: Contact name must have a minimum length of 5 characters

$.metadata.contact[*].email.description: Contact email MUST be a valid email address

value_constraint.description: Contact email must conform to standard email address syntax

$.metadata.contact[*].affiliation.description: Contact affiliation MUST be at least 2 characters long

value_constraint.description: Contact affiliation must have a minimum length of 2 characters

$.metadata.contact[*].orcid.description: Contact ORCID is recommended and, when provided, MUST match the standard 16-digit ORCID format (XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX)

value_constraint.description: ORCID identifier must match pattern ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{3}[X0-9]$

$.metadata.sample.description: At least one biological or experimental sample MUST be defined in metadata for MetaboLights submissions

value_constraint.description: Requires at least 1 sample entry in metadata.sample

$.metadata.sample[*].description: Each sample entry MUST define name and species, and is recommended to include tissue and cell_type

$.metadata.sample[*].name.description: Sample name MUST be at least 2 characters long

value_constraint.description: Sample name must have a minimum length of 2 characters

$.metadata.sample[*].species.description: Each sample MUST specify at least one species ontology term

value_constraint.description: Requires at least 1 species CV term in sample.species

$.metadata.sample[*].species[*].description: Sample species CV terms MUST be sourced from NCBITAXON, ENVO, or CHEBI ontologies (user-defined terms are not permitted)

value_constraint.description: Species ontology term must belong to NCBITAXON, ENVO, or CHEBI

$.metadata.ms_run.description: At least one MS run MUST be defined in metadata

value_constraint.description: Requires at least 1 MS run entry in metadata.ms_run

$.metadata.ms_run[*].description: Each MS run entry MUST define its data file location

$.metadata.assay.description: At least one assay MUST be defined in metadata

value_constraint.description: Requires at least 1 assay entry in metadata.assay

$.metadata.assay[*].description: Each assay entry MUST define name, ms_run_ref, and sample_ref for MetaboLights submissions

$.metadata.assay[*].sample_ref.description: Each assay sample_ref MUST be a non-null positive integer (>= 1) referencing a declared sample

value_constraint.description: Assay sample_ref must be a positive integer (>= 1) and cannot be null

$.metadata.protocol.description: Metadata protocols MUST include all 6 required MetaboLights protocol types (EFO:0005518, EFO:0000490, CHMO:0000470, CHMO:0001000, OBI:0200000, MI:2131)

value_constraint.description: Requires at least 1 protocol and all 6 standard MetaboLights protocol CV accessions to be present

$.metadata.protocol[*].description: Each protocol entry MUST define both name and type

$.metadata.protocol[*].name.description: Protocol name MUST be a valid string

value_constraint.description: Validates that protocol name is a string value

$.metadata.protocol[*].type.description: Validation rules for protocol type CV term definitions

requirements.description: Protocol type MUST be a valid ontology CV term or user-defined parameter

value_constraint.description: Protocol type must be a valid CV term (user-defined terms allowed)

$.metadata.study_variable_group.description: At least one study variable group MUST be defined in metadata for MetaboLights submissions

value_constraint.description: Requires at least 1 study variable group entry in metadata.study_variable_group

$.metadata.study_variable_group[*].description: Each study variable group MUST define name and type, and is recommended to define datatype

$.metadata.study_variable_group[*].name.description: Study variable group name MUST be either a valid CV term or a string of at least 2 characters

value_constraint.description: Study variable group name must satisfy either the CV term constraint or minimum string length of 2

constraints.description: Validates study variable group name as a CV term (user-defined terms allowed)
Validates study variable group name as a string of at least 2 characters

$.metadata.study_variable[*].description: Each study variable MUST define name, group_refs, and assay_refs

$.metadata.study_variable[*].group_refs.description: Each study variable MUST reference at least one study variable group in group_refs

value_constraint.description: Requires at least 1 group reference in study_variable.group_refs

$.metadata.study_variable[*].assay_refs.description: Each study variable MUST reference at least one assay in assay_refs

value_constraint.description: Requires at least 1 assay reference in study_variable.assay_refs

$.smallMoleculeSummary.description: The smallMoleculeSummary (SML) table MUST be present and contain at least one summary row

value_constraint.description: Requires at least 1 entry in smallMoleculeSummary
